| Launch | $0.106/CU-hour | $0.35/GB-month | Up to 16 CU | Startups and growing production apps |
| Scale | $0.222/CU-hour | $0.35/GB-month | Up to 16 CU autoscaling (or fixed sizes up to 56 CU) | Production needing compliance and SLAs | [...] The exact same database on Scale ($0.222/CU-hour) costs about $683. Neon’s own pricing page lands in the same range: it quotes a typical spend of $701 a month on Scale for a high-load, 100 GB database, and $15 a month on Launch for an intermittent 1 GB one. [...] One quick accuracy check before you budget: if you are reading an older comparison, verify its numbers. A lot of guides still quote a $5 monthly minimum on Launch, a $69 minimum on Scale, or $0.14/CU-hour compute. All three are out of date. Neon removed the minimums in December 2025 and cut Launch compute to $0.106/CU-hour, so any total built on the old figures is too high.

results.title: Neon Pricing 2026: Plans, Costs & Limits
results.snippet:
Summarize with AI



Share article



Neon pricing starts with a free plan; paid Launch and Scale plans charge for actual usage with no monthly minimum. Database compute costs $0.106 per CU-hour on Launch and $0.222 on Scale, with storage billed separately. The main budget question is how much compute runs, and for how long—not how many colleagues log in. [...] | Plan | Billing | Database allowance or rate | When it fits |
 ---  --- |
| Free | $0; no annual commitment | 100 CU-hours and 0.5 GB storage per project | Experiments and small workloads within every free limit |
| Launch | Usage billed monthly; no fixed annual equivalent | $0.106/CU-hour; $0.35/GB-month | Applications that exceed Free without requiring Scale controls |

results.title: Neon Pricing Calculator (2026) — Estimate Your Monthly Bill
results.snippet:
A side project with scale-to-zero can cost as little as $1–3/month. A production SaaS on 1 CU always-on runs about $78/month before storage. Neon has no monthly minimum on the Launch plan — you pay only for what you use.

### Does Neon have a free plan?

Yes. The Free plan includes 100 CU-hours/month, 0.5 GB storage, and up to 2 CU autoscale. It is suitable for development and side projects. The Launch plan removes these limits and enables scale-to-zero with configurable autoscale up to 8 CU. [...] ## How Neon pricing works in 2026

Neon is a serverless Postgres database with two distinct billing dimensions: compute andstorage. Compute is measured in Compute Units (CU) — one CU equals 1 vCPU and 4 GB RAM — and billed per hour of active use at$0.106/CU-hour on the Launch plan. Storage is$0.35/GB-month. Egress is 100 GB/month included, then $0.10/GB. [...] Neon Launch

results.snippet:
1 extra branch × 1 month = 1 branch-month

Cost: $1.50/branch-month (~$0.002/hour).

Example: The Launch plan includes 10 branches/project. You create 2 extra branches for 5 hours each → 10 extra branch-hours × $0.002/hour = ~$0.02 total.

> Extra branches are not available on the Free plan. Delete branches or upgrade if you need more.
